name: noop-cloudflare
description: Deploy your own Noop Worker to Cloudflare with one click.

HUB_TOKEN.description: The machine token your computers use to connect. Use a long random string, for example the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`, and keep it: the primary machine needs it.

HUB_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email address. Only this address can sign in.
